## Diagnostic failures and bounded production correction

All 32 units finished: 28 passed; two burst units, `runtime-full`, and
`broad-01` reported failure. Both burst units' PostgreSQL cells passed;
each SQLite cell contained eight nonretryable `workspace_tool_outcome_uncertain`
deliveries with `response_not_observed`. Runtime failures name the dependency,
target and fork-registration gaps above. All broad Go tests passed, but its
service cleanup correctly refused a still-held lease. Inspection found the
fixture's orphaned shell holding that exact lease; it was retired, not ignored.

The HTTP owner `toolgateway.HTTPObservation.rpc` applies its five-second
observation timeout to `tools/call` too. A real six-second HTTP result with a
still-live ten-second caller reproduces the wrong uncertainty at five seconds.
This is a branch-owned correction within #2555's existing transport boundary,
not a new owner: initialize/list retain their independent bound; business
calls consume the existing caller/worker deadline and cancellation. A late but
valid result must not become uncertain solely because it exceeded a discovery
budget. Lost responses and post-dispatch cancellation remain uncertain,
nonretryable, redacted and unreplayed. The authoritative startup-probe contract
is amended in `platform-spec.yaml` alongside code.

The same HTTP owner serves native mock calls, host/Docker workspace probes and
the free doctor initialize request; discovery cannot gain business-call
permission or an unbounded probe. Add real HTTP slow-result, bounded-discovery
and cancellation/request-join controls. Existing lost-client and lost-reply
controls remain binding. Re-run the four failed units without cross-unit
fail-fast, and record the full results before the ONE next qualifying full.

No assertion, workload size, deadline, workflow, provider selection, schema,
vendoring, compatibility path or product owner is relaxed. The cleanup issue
is test-fixture debt under existing #2353, not a test-service rewrite. Q01's
hosted default-network proof and final integrated qualification remain open;
the diagnostic cannot close either. The complete sweep report must be posted
on #2555 before qualification begins.
